Persistent data clean-up after Software Cluster re-
moval
⌈

shall remove persistent data of a removed
SoftwareCluster
by ag-

tive Platform
and the file system clean.
⌋

RS_UCM_00004)
For more details, please refer to [SWS_PER_00397] in Persistency Specification [11].
